$comment: Default permissions. 'allow' = reading and verification, which change nothing and need no prompt. 'deny' = what the fleet's discipline forbids without an explicit order. 'ask' = irreversible or externally visible. Adjust the test/build commands to the project's package manager.

env.$comment: A delegated job returns a handle immediately, but an MCP server cannot wake this session — the completion notification comes from the host backgrounding the *_await call. At the 2-minute default, calling await right after start costs two minutes of a blocked turn, so people poll instead and lose the notification entirely. Lower it and await frees the turn in seconds while still delivering the result as a notification. Applies to every MCP server, not just the executors.
